text: The protagonist, Alex, woke up to the sound of rain drumming against the windowpane. A sense of unease lingered from the previous night's strange dream.
Downstairs, the old grandfather clock chimed ten times. Alex remembered the cryptic message found tucked inside its casing days ago.
Later, Alex met with Dr. Aris Thorne at the university library. Thorne, an expert in ancient symbols, seemed unusually nervous.
